attackers_goals: An attacker is attempting to collect sensitive email information.
description: A user sent sensitive email messages to external users.
detection_modules: Identity Threat Module, SaaS Threat Detection, Email
investigative_actions: Look for signs that the user account and mailboxes are compromised (e.g. abnormal logins, unusual activity). Follow further actions done by the account. Look for unusual email patterns from the affected mailbox (e.g. unusual email contents). Examine the user's email activity history for suspicious behavior.
